plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Rewrites a vague prompt in the box into a specific one, using the project's instructions, skills and the chat so far, then sends it on Send

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: Side questions about the current chat in a pane beside it, with follow-ups in the same thread, kept out of the main conversation

plugins.name: prompt-style
plugins.description: Draws your own prompts in the transcript beside an orange bar instead of on a full-width grey band

plugins.name: transcript
plugins.description: Opens this chat as Markdown in nvim in a Mado float, to read and search it

plugins.name: idea-shelf
plugins.description: Keeps the ideas that come up while you code, one shelf per project, in a pane you come back to; /idea saves one out of the main conversation

plugins.name: task-board
plugins.description: A task list per project, to do → in progress → done, that the agent keeps current as it plans and works, with the steps only you can take marked as yours; /board opens it in a pane

plugins.name: paste-thumbnails
plugins.description: Shows a thumbnail of each image pasted into the prompt box in the band above it, labelled with its [Image #N] tag
